team_notes.CLE: Shedeur Sanders named starter vs HOU over Watson (Akron Beacon Journal, Nov 11).

team_notes.KC: Mahomes (right elbow strain/sprain) day-to-day; practice managed this week, Fields gets reps (Rapoport/Reid, Nov 9).
team_notes.LA: Puka Nacua (knee MCL/PCL sprain) out, likely IR, at least a month (CBS/DK Network, Nov 10-11).

team_notes.NE: Stevenson (plantaris) out next few weeks (Rapoport, Nov 9); Henderson out (medical emergency). Corey Kiner expected lead back, Lan Larison behind (RotoWire Nov 10). Game in Munich.
team_notes.DAL: Jake Ferguson (knee) out; Tyler Goodson (knee) out multiple weeks, Javonte Williams the only other healthy back; Pickens (hamstring) has a chance (DK Network, Nov 10).

team_notes.CHI: Monangai out until Wk11; Luther Burden concussion (Nov 8).

team_notes.NYJ: Breece Hall led Wk9 (15 carries to Braelon Allen's 8); Garrett Wilson concussion.
team_notes.NYG: McCarthy and Skattebo off the final injury report (Giants.com, Nov 11); both play Thu.
team_notes.MIA: Malik Willis (groin) to IR; Kyle McCord starts (ESPN, Nov 10).
team_notes.LV: Cousins traded to MIN; rookie Fernando Mendoza named starter vs SEA (Raiders.com, Nov 10).
